params.leaderWindow: frame 0 = measured current frame t, frames 1..30 = ground-truth future (stands in for the mapping prediction)
params.avatar: ground-truth pose at t (velocities/positions/rotations/contacts) placed at the measured root of t
params.boneLengthRestore: joints in order (parents first); if |child-parent| > tol*len: child moved to that distance, same delta applied to all descendants (Unity Transform semantics)
params.eulerBlend: world = lerp(M_new*p, prevWorld + R_new*v*dt, eulerRatio) before bone restore
params.rootCorrection: new root (x,z) and yaw blended towards measuredRm by rootCorrection (0 = off)
params.layout: channel-major flat[c*T + t]; rotations 9 per joint row-major m00 m01 m02 m10 .. m22
